title: BEAR: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Relational Knowledge in Causal and Masked Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the variance in model accuracy when queried with different semantically equivalent templates for the same relational knowledge instances.

Comparing the performance of language models trained on different corpora (e.g., Wikipedia vs. domain-specific text like PubMed) to evaluate the impact of pre-training data on factual knowledge retrieval and assess overrepresentation advantages.
